# Indexes (rebuilt on refresh)

def build_indexes():
    global channels_list, categorized_channels, users_list
    channel_stats = df.groupby("channel_id").agg(
        channel_name=("channel_name", "first"),
        message_count=("message_id", "count")
    ).reset_index()
    channel_stats = channel_stats.sort_values("message_count", ascending=False)
    channels_list = channel_stats.to_dict(orient="records")
    categorized_channels = categorize_channels(channels_list)
    user_counts = df["author"].value_counts() if len(df) else pd.Series(dtype=int)
    users_list = [{"name": str(k), "count": int(v)} for k, v in user_counts.items()]
